## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the exact checks performed and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on the repository that owns the affected behavior.
- [ ] Applicable repository verification passes.
- [ ] Public behavior and examples are documented.
- [ ] Protocol changes include corresponding specification, schema, registry, example, and test-vector updates where applicable.
- [ ] Security-sensitive information and credentials are absent from the pull request.
